services.shortDesc: Web applications built end-to-end with React, Node.js, and a database that fits the problem.
services.intro: I build web applications end-to-end — frontend, backend, database, and deployment — rather than handing off pieces to different specialists. That means fewer integration surprises and a single person who understands the whole system when something needs to change.
problems: You need a web application built from scratch, not just a design handed to a developer
An existing app needs a feature added, a bug fixed, or a backend rebuilt
You need an API that a frontend, mobile app, or third party can consume
User accounts, authentication, and permissions need to be done properly
The app needs to actually get deployed and stay running, not just work on localhost
services.ctaSub: Tell me what you're trying to build and I'll tell you honestly whether it's a good fit.

services.shortDesc: Turning repetitive spreadsheet and file work into a script that runs itself.
services.intro: A lot of office and research work is the same manual steps repeated on slightly different data every time — cleaning a CSV, merging spreadsheets, generating a report. If you can describe the steps, there's a decent chance they can be automated with a Python script instead of done by hand every week.
problems: The same CSV/Excel cleanup or reformatting happens every week or month
Data from multiple spreadsheets or sources needs to be combined and reconciled
A recurring report currently gets built manually and could be generated automatically
A small internal tool would save real time but doesn't need a full web app
Data needs to move between a spreadsheet and a real database
services.ctaText: Doing the same manual data task every week?
services.ctaSub: Describe the repetitive task and I'll tell you if a script makes sense.

services.seoTitle: Open Journal Systems (OJS) Support, Upgrade & Troubleshooting
services.shortDesc: Upgrades, plugins, email, HTTPS, and production troubleshooting for real OJS installations.
services.intro: I administered and upgraded a production OJS installation for a university's Electrical Engineering department — real journals, real submission cycles, real consequences when something breaks. If your OJS installation has a problem that needs an actual administrator rather than a generic web developer, this is that.
problems: OJS installation or initial setup
Upgrading between OJS versions (including 3.x version jumps) without breaking active journals
Plugin compatibility issues after an upgrade
SMTP and email delivery problems — notifications not sending, variables not replacing correctly
DOI and ORCID configuration
Journal workflow and submission process issues
HTTPS configuration and reverse proxy problems
Apache configuration for OJS
Database troubleshooting and migration
Article view/metric counts not displaying correctly
Indexing problems (search engines, DOAJ, etc.)
Security hardening for a production installation
Performance troubleshooting on a slow installation
User and role permission issues
services.ctaSub: I can help troubleshoot upgrades, email, plugins, permissions, HTTPS, indexing, and production issues.

services.shortDesc: Smart contracts written, tested, and deployed with Foundry — plus the frontend that talks to them.
services.intro: I build Solidity smart contracts and the Foundry-based testing and deployment workflow around them, along with the React/ethers.js frontend that lets people actually use the contract. I don't position this as professional security auditing — it's practical smart contract development and defensive engineering practices, not a formal audit.
problems: A smart contract needs to be designed and written from a real requirement
An existing contract needs a proper Foundry test suite (unit tests, fuzz tests)
Deployment scripting for testnets like Sepolia
Frontend integration — connecting a React app to a deployed contract via ethers.js
Debugging unexpected contract behavior or failing transactions
Reviewing contract architecture for common defensive-engineering patterns (reentrancy, access control, oracle safety)
services.ctaText: Building or debugging a Solidity project?
services.ctaSub: Tell me about the contract or the problem you're running into.

services.seoTitle: Practical AI & LLM Integration for Web Applications
services.shortDesc: Wiring LLM APIs into real applications — chat interfaces, prompt handling, tool calling.
services.intro: This is practical software integration work, not AI research — connecting an LLM API to a real application, designing the prompt and system behavior around it, and handling the parts (rate limits, context management, tool calling) that make the difference between a demo and something that holds up with real users.
problems: An application needs a chat interface backed by an LLM API (e.g. Groq, OpenAI-compatible APIs)
Prompt design and system-prompt structure for consistent, constrained outputs
Tool/function calling — letting a model take real actions through your application safely
Managing conversation context and history sensibly as costs and context windows grow
General AI agent experimentation and prototyping
services.ctaText: Want to add AI to an existing application?
services.ctaSub: Tell me what you're trying to build and what the model needs to do.
